spec_match.rationale: The live status panel probes the exact removed and surviving Document methods without calling the removed one; the visual model illustrates the (top-site, embedded-origin) partition key the removal defaults embeds back to.

interactive.rationale: Model tabs toggle the two storage diagrams, and the refresh button re-runs the real capability probe.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card (updated this refile to say 'pre-removal' instead of the predecessor's incorrect 'pre-150').

edge_cases.rationale: Both the still-exposed and removed states have distinct honest status text; the visual model is explicitly a model, with the live probe kept separate.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5162221567082496 and MDN partitioned cookies.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the new v153 feature suite; the page's probe matches the suite's removal/survivor split.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run passed desktop+mobile after final edits (screenshots read). CDP sweep toggled both model tabs (display block/none verified), read the status grid, and clicked refresh; zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; the aria-live status grid records each probe outcome as text.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables with color-mix derivations of the accent tokens only; tab buttons override background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Status panel is a labelled section with an aria-live grid; tabs are native buttons; diagram semantics are backed by textual insight boxes.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the storage diagram collapses to one column under 480px and the status grid under 640px.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive migration wizard step tabs without horizontal overflow on mobile

guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: storage-diagram and status-grid both collapse via media queries; harness confirmed no overflow at 360px.

summary: v153 refile of partition-visualizer. Fixed two factual errors from the predecessor: rSAFor required a user gesture on the top-level page (not 'no user interaction'), and the removal is the Chrome 153 stepped-rollout step rather than something that already happened in 152; also renamed the 'Pre-150' tab to 'Pre-removal'. Verified via the responsive harness and a CDP tab/refresh sweep with zero console errors.
